# cloud-lab

> A documentation-first personal Cloudflare lab framework: capability knowledge tree, proposed interfaces, authority boundaries and staged migration of existing tools.

Tier: ungraded
Status: partial
Interfaces: http, cli, spec
Entrypoint: https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/SDD.md
Auth: Access JWT and per-principal HMAC + server-side scoped grants; first live machine loop verified; full acceptance pending
Spec: https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/contracts/m1.openapi.json

M1 provides a local-tested Worker, SQL outbox, fixed-minute scheduler, Python OS collector and native dashboard. An isolated Access-protected deployment has one validated real runner result; full human/mobile/fault/recovery qualification remains pending. No existing application has migrated. Existing product authorities and runtime boundaries remain unchanged. Document verification does not establish a usable product.

## Interface reference

- [Contracts](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/contracts/README.md): proposed identity, commands, external runs, events, artifacts and recipes.
- [Knowledge tree](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/knowledge-tree.md): capabilities, responsibilities, source implementations and evidence gaps.
- [SUCCESS](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/SUCCESS.md): document milestone and pending product acceptance.

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/architecture.md): state ownership, independent deployment and CF mapping.
- [Migration](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/migration.md): candidate destinations, cutover, rollback and retirement gates.
- [Verification](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/verification.md): M0 document checks and future runtime acceptance.
- [Sources](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/sources.md): pinned public sources and official documentation.

- [Headless OAuth](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/headless-oauth.md): callback paste workflow and evidence-based troubleshooting.
- [Live operations](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/live-operations.md): private receipts, provisioning order and bounded verification.
- [First live evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-first-live.md): actual runtime, one machine loop and remaining gaps.
- [Isolated restore](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-isolated-restore.md): real D1 snapshot equality, journal reconciliation and preserved pending work; no production failover.

- [Resident runner](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/resident-runner.md): bounded user-service lifecycle; automatic command pickup and same-journal restart qualified, full recovery pending.
- [Resident evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-resident.md): 98 tests, independent review and bounded live user-service qualification.
- [Recovery qualification](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/recovery-qualification.md): isolated real-process crash and lost-report harness, with actual local workerd/D1 evidence and explicit remote gaps.

- [Remote recovery and revocation](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-remote-recovery.md): three isolated real-CF fault cases, revoked grants, disabled test Access token and preserved unknown; original resources unchanged, full acceptance pending.

- [Dashboard browser evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-dashboard.md): local Chromium/workerd/D1, auth expiry, uncertain retry identity, stale-response rejection and narrow layouts; subsequent reviewed asset rollout verified automatically, real human Access pending; physical-phone testing is optional.

- [Dashboard rollout](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/dashboard-rollout.md): reviewed assets deployed, original settings and application rows retained, anonymous requests return302 and machine reads pass; human browser workflow pending; physical-phone testing waived as a required gate.

- [Authorization lifecycle](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/authorization-lifecycle.md): strict offline metadata status and private same-scope grant renewal/revocation plans;144local tests and synthetic CLI verified, no automatic apply/rotation; source collection is documented separately.

- [Authorization collection](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/authorization-collection.md): fixed read-only Worker/D1/Access metadata with source provenance and drift checks;161tests and five original-Lab reads verified, HMAC/runner unknown, no renewal.
- [Collection evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-authorization-collection.md): independent source review and lead-verified live metadata; all four grants and selected token expired, active0 and schedules off at observation.

- [Machine self authorization](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/self-authorization.md): authenticated own-HMAC metadata and runner inspection CLI without job dispatch; subsequently deployed and checked in the bounded OL window. Standalone query omits resident and Access expiry; nonce storage still writes.

- [Self-authorization evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-self-authorization.md):176local tests, real loopback inspection and cancellable slow-stream boundary; initial failures retained, no live rollout or renewal.

- [Resident process observation](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/resident-observation.md): opt-in Linux private Unix socket, peer/start/boot identity, loaded config digest and actual FLOCK ownership; conservative stop deadline and crash/drift rejection. Subsequently installed and observed on the original Lab; validation resident stopped after observation.

- [Resident observation evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-resident-observation.md):192tests, real fixture resident/kernel-lock observations, signal/restart/crash and drift checks, independent review; no original-service rollout or authorization change.

- [Integrated authorization](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/integrated-authorization.md): correlates management, machine self and resident metadata with identity/config binding, before/after drift checks and conservative timestamps; private snapshot/provenance integrity status, no automatic deployment or renewal.

- [Integration evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-integrated-authorization.md): real local HTTP/HMAC/SQLite and kernel socket integration with synthetic management envelopes; source-only acceptance and explicit unknown route/policy/live state.

- [Observation rollout preparation](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/observation-rollout.md): pinned source candidate, read-only baseline, bounded machine-only window proposal and compensating rollback; preparation history precedes the separately approved OL execution.

- [Rollout preparation evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-observation-rollout-plan.md): lead read-only metadata and private source checks, explicit failures and pending live gates.

- [Bounded observation live evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-observation-live.md): approved machine-only expiry changes, pinned Worker/runner update, actual AS/SA/RO observation and clean early stop; business rows/journal/policy unchanged, human/scheduler expired, no natural-expiry or full-product acceptance claim.

- [Service runner](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/service-runner.md): config-bound private service policy, startup self verification, minimum fixed deadlines and journal-safe recovery; no automatic renewal or live enablement.

- [Service runner evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-service-runner.md): local HTTP/subprocess expiry, rejection and journal recovery evidence; separate from real Cloudflare acceptance.

- [Service activation preparation](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/service-activation.md): offline private non-executable proposal, explicit relative windows and request estimates; pinned runner candidate and read-only baseline, no live renewal/start.

- [Service activation evidence](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-service-activation.md):249local tests, private CLI and unit validation; unknown D1/billing and stale metadata preserved.

- [Routine service activation](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/platform/cloud-lab/docs/evidence/m1-service-live.md): owner-confirmed Free, approved runner-only renewal and seven-day service started; self/resident verified and active at final readback, fixed ceiling2026-11-05T07:24:26Z; bot/human/scheduler expired, schedules off, future uptime/expiry and billing unverified.
